nodes.label: PandaPools Cloud Anchor — Beacon Re-announcer
nodes.rationale: Proactive, always-on beacon refresh replacing the app's reactive re-announce, which only fired after a beacon had already pruned (a guaranteed dark window) and was unreliable under Samsung Doze throttling of the 6h WorkManager. Diagnosed 2026-07-15 from live-chain data: 6 pools each had exactly one create-time beacon and the newest was ~18h old. Runs on the always-on eurobuddha megammr node (RPC 127.0.0.1:9005) via a systemd timer every 2.5h; re-announces before the ~24h prune when a funded pool's newest beacon exceeds PP_STALE_BLOCKS (~900 blocks / ~12h).

nodes.label: Pool Registry Beacon (unspendable sentinel dust)
nodes.rationale: A pool's registry beacon is unspendable dust at the sentinel 0x50414E4441504F4F4C53 that MMR-prunes ~a day after posting; beacons are grouped per pool by opk|tok|kmin state and refreshed by re-sending 0.000000001 MINIMA carrying the same state map verbatim.

nodes.label: Covenant Reconstruction and parseok Gate
nodes.rationale: The anchor reconstructs the 0.5% covenant byte-identical to PoolCovenant.TEMPLATE, gates on runscript parseok, derives the pool address, and only re-announces pools that are on-chain funded.

nodes.label: Anchor Fund-Safety Model
nodes.rationale: Read-only except a dust send to the unspendable sentinel, funded from the node wallet with change back. Never spends a covenant/pool coin, never signs an owner key — identical trust model to PoolManager.reannounce and the MDS poolmgr.reannounce.

nodes.label: Faucet Auto-Funding
nodes.rationale: Auto-tops-up from a co-located faucet when sendable < PP_MIN_SENDABLE; each beacon costs ~1e-9 MINIMA so a fraction of a MINIMA lasts years.
